data_window: 2026-08-18 00:00 to 2026-08-21 10:20 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API queries covered ai agent, mcp agent, browser agent, code agent, voice agent, RAG agent, and AI workflow with both created:>=2026-08-18 and pushed:>=2026-08-18 sort=updated strategies. Raw responses were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_21_*.json; selected README and repository metadata audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_21_readmes/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main; pre-existing unrelated frontend/deploy worktree changes and the untracked 2026-08-19 Lark retry note were preserved unstaged. Discovery used unauthenticated GitHub Search API metadata plus selected README audits through the GitHub API raw README endpoint. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, mobile-tested, MCP-handshake-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, payment-tested, security-scanned or deployed.
trend_observations: Today clustered around native/local coding agents, evidence and memory layers for long-running agents, MCP/tool-call governance, desktop/browser computer-use substrates, multi-agent workflow builders and vertical MCP product surfaces. The strongest projects expose concrete CLI, desktop, API, MCP, Docker, live-demo, release, screenshot or documentation surfaces. Thin prompt guides, course/event repositories, resource collections and concept-only READMEs were downgraded.
assumptions: Scores are editorial point-in-time rankings based on GitHub Search API metadata, README evidence, visible product surface, install/build cues, documentation completeness, repository freshness and AI-native workflow depth. Stars and forks are snapshots from unauthenticated GitHub Search API, not exact growth deltas. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. Pure skill/content collections, learning notes, prompt collections, event/course repos, thin wrappers and concept-only READMEs were downgraded or skipped.
